description: Read the ETH and USDC balance of any address on Base mainnet (chain 8453) straight from the chain, plus transaction count and how many x402 calls the USDC covers. Use it to check your own agent wallet before a paid workflow, to verify a counterparty was paid, or to monitor treasury addresses. Params: address (required, 0x...). Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"address":"0x622efA6Ceb83a5b6EdBC931332f4db68B7f74F27"}.
name: evm_balance
